title: Santorini Caldera Escape
shortDescription: Cliffside suites, sunset sails, and volcanic wine tastings.
description: Six unhurried days along the Santorini caldera: private-terrace stays carved into the cliffs, a catamaran sunset sail past the volcano, and a walking tour of the island's oldest wineries. Built for couples who want the postcard view without the crowds.
